title: 5 Trends for 2020
notes: TrendWatching Quarterly, November 2019 issue (URL path quarterly/2019-11; earliest 200 capture found is 2019-12-13). Labels from the numbered overview and section headings. The full 2020 Trend Report (Premium) is not captured. target_year 2020 from the title.

entries.label: GREEN PRESSURE
entries.quote: That’s why in 2020, millions of consumers will seek out products, services and experiences that help them alleviate rising eco-shame.
entries.subject: Eco-shame driving sustainable consumption
entries.note: Dek: 'In 2020, consumers move from eco-status to eco-shame.'

entries.label: BRAND AVATARS
entries.quote: In 2020, consumers will pay deeper attention to brands who embody themselves via new virtual characters and avatars, allowing them to inhabit digital channels in richer, more immersive and more human ways.
entries.subject: Virtual brand characters and avatars
entries.note: Dek: 'Human brands take powerful new form.'

entries.label: METAMORPHIC DESIGN
entries.quote: In 2020 consumers primed by constantly evolving digital services and smart physical spaces – and accustomed to the ultra-convenience of ‘everything as a service’ – will increasingly expect relevance as a service , too.
entries.subject: Products and services that adapt to the user
entries.note: Dek: 'Consumers demand relevance as a service.'

entries.label: THE BURNOUT
entries.quote: In 2020, those consumers will look to brands to help them battle THE BURNOUT.
entries.subject: Burnout and mental wellbeing
entries.note: Dek: 'Smart brands rush to help those burned by the pressures of modern life.' Section cites survey data (Microsoft, Cigna, National Working Families Report) about the present, not forecasts.

entries.label: CIVIL MEDIA
entries.quote: In 2020 consumers will seek an antidote to vast and toxic online communities and social media platforms.
entries.subject: Smaller, respectful online communities
entries.note: Dek: 'Why the future of social is meaningful connections.'
